changes.name: Damp paper drying rule
changes.authorQuote: For future scenes, a damp paper copy must dry flat before anyone turns its pages.

value.requirement: A damp paper copy must be laid out flat and allowed to dry fully before anyone turns its pages.
value.scope: All future scenes involving damp paper copies.
value.handling: Lay the copy flat, support it evenly, and wait until it is dry before any page is turned.
invariants: No page of a damp paper copy is turned until the copy has dried flat.
